options.name: Quiet wordmark
options.summary: Full name in the header. A bone jar on charcoal for the native icon. Recommended.
options.tradeoff: Most restrained header. The small jar carries less detail at 16px; the name stays legible beside it in taskbar labels.

options.name: Jar + name
options.summary: The existing jar-and-name pairing, fitted to a UI header. The established lime app icon.
options.tradeoff: Strongest continuity with the current website lockup. The jar repeats beside the app name and makes the header wider.

options.name: Light tile
options.summary: Full-name header with a charcoal jar on a bone tile. Same letterforms, stronger icon silhouette.
options.tradeoff: Clear silhouette on a dark taskbar. The pale tile is more noticeable and less quiet beside the mascot’s own bone tile.
